paym.restUdhaar: Bahar se aaye paise bill se kam hain: Rs. {{n}} is gahak ke udhaar mein jayenge.

udhaar.title: Udhaar (credit)
udhaar.body: Gahak cheez abhi le leta hai aur paise baad mein deta hai, saare ya kuch. Jo baqi rahein woh us ke khate mein likhe rehte hain jab tak woh de na de. English software mein isay "credit" kehte hain.
udhaar.example: Phone Rs. 50,000. Abhi 20,000 diye → 30,000 us ke khate mein udhaar.

khata.title: Khata
khata.body: Har shakhs (gahak, dealer, doosri dukaan) ka ek safha jis mein us ke saath har bill aur har len den hai. Is se pata chalta hai ke us se kitne lene hain ya usay kitne dene hain.
khata.example: Bilal ka khata: 30,000 ka udhaar, 10,000 diye → us se 20,000 lene hain.

cost.title: Khareed qeemat
cost.body: Dukaan ne cheez jitne mein khareedi. Yeh sirf malik aur manager ko nazar aati hai. Munafa isi se nikalta hai.

asking.title: Bechne ki qeemat
asking.body: Jis qeemat par bechne ka irada hai. Yeh khareed qeemat se kam nahi ho sakti. Counter par badal sakte hain, aur nuqsan par sirf malik ya manager bech sakta hai.

profit.title: Munafa
profit.body: Bechne ki qeemat mein se khareed qeemat nikaal kar jo bache. "Kharche ke baad munafa" mein us waqt ka kiraya, bill, tankhwahein aur baqi kharche bhi nikale jate hain.
profit.example: 52,000 mein becha, 45,000 mein khareeda tha → munafa 7,000.

pta.title: PTA status
pta.body: PTA approved: phone Pakistan mein register hai, har SIM chalti hai. Non-PTA: register nahi, SIM thore din hi chalti hai. JV / patch: PTA se bachne ke liye phone mein tabdeeli ki gayi hai; khareed-farokht mein khatra hai.
pta.example: Bahar se aaya iPhone jis par PTA tax nahi diya: Non-PTA.

imei.title: IMEI
imei.body: 15 hindson ka number jo sirf usi ek phone ka hota hai. Phone par *#06# milayein ya dabbe par dekhein. App isi se phone ki kahani nikalti hai aur chori ke phone se khabardar karti hai.

idcheck.title: ID card check
idcheck.body: Jab gahak se purana phone khareedein to us ke CNIC aur chehre ki tasweer rakh lein. Agar phone chori ka nikla to aap dikha sakte hain ke kis ne becha. Jaanne wale ke liye chhor bhi sakte hain.
idcheck.example: CNIC ka aaga aur peechha, bechne wale ki tasweer aur phone ki tasweer.

opening.title: Purana stock
opening.body: Woh phone jo app shuru karne se pehle dukaan mein maujood the. Inhein ek dafa daal dein taake stock poora ho. Abhi koi paise nahi diye jate, is liye din ka hisaab nahi badalta.
opening.example: Pehle din shelf par rakhe 25 phone daal dein.

cut.title: Wapsi par dukaan ki katoti
cut.body: Jab gahak phone wapas laye to dukaan kuch paise rakh kar baqi wapas kar sakti hai. Jo dukaan rakhe woh aamdani mein gina jata hai.
cut.example: 1,00,000 mein becha, 90,000 wapas diye → dukaan ki katoti 10,000.

inHand.title: Haath mein bache
inHand.body: Us waqt mein jitne paise aaye un mein se jitne gaye (bikri, adaigiyan, kharche, stock ki khareed, wapsiyan). Stock par lage paise ab dukaan mein phone ki shakal mein hain, yeh nuqsan nahi.

warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.body: Kharabi ki soorat mein dukaan kitne arse tak theek karegi ya badlegi. Yeh raseed par chhapti hai.
warranty.example: 1 mahine ki warranty: mahine ke andar koi kharabi dukaan ki zimmedari.

tid.title: TID
tid.body: Transaction ID: online payment ke baad bank app ya SMS mein aane wala number. Likh lein to baad mein koi sawal ho to payment dhoondna aasaan hai.

cheque.title: Cheque
cheque.body: Bank ke cheque se payment. Paise account mein tab aate hain jab cheque clear ho, is liye app cheque alag "Cheques" khate mein rakhti hai.
cheque.example: HBL ka cheque number 00123456, tareekh 5 November.

remittance.title: Bahar se paise
remittance.body: Khareedne wale ke ghar wale doosre mulk se paise bhejte hain (Western Union, bank waghera). Un ki currency mein raqam aur rate likhein, rupay app khud nikaal deti hai.

void.title: Bill cancel karna
void.body: Ghalti se bana bill khatam karta hai. Kuch mitaya nahi jata: app ulti entry daal deti hai, is liye kahani aur hisaab dono theek rehte hain.
void.example: Ek bikri do dafa chadh gayi: ek cancel kar dein.

fp.explain: Password ki jagah ek touch se login. Aap ka fingerprint phone mein hi rehta hai, kahin nahi jata.
fp.turnOn: Is phone ke liye on karein
fp.cancelled: Fingerprint ki tasdeeq nahi hui. Dobara koshish karein.
fp.staffAllowed: Staff bhi fingerprint se login kar sake

remind.title: Udhaar ki yaad dahani
remind.autoHint: Yaad dahani WhatsApp par khud-ba-khud jaati hai. Ek bande ke liye us par dabayein, ya sab ko bhejein.
remind.handHint: Bande par dabayein: WhatsApp message ke saath khulta hai, aap bas send dabayein. "Sab ko bhejein" ek ek kar ke dikhata hai.
remind.openEach: Neeche har naam par daba kar us ki yaad dahani WhatsApp par bhejein.

plan.dueToday: Aap ki subscription aaj khatam ho rahi hai. Renew karein.
plan.expired: Aap ki subscription khatam ho gayi hai. App ke save karna band karne mein {{n}} din baqi hain.
plan.locked: Aap ki subscription khatam ho gayi hai. App ab sirf data dikhati hai; jari rakhne ke liye renew karein.
plan.waText: Assalam-o-Alaikum, main apni Mobile Shop subscription renew karwana chahta hoon.

offline.noNet: Internet nahi hai. Bikri, stock, adaigi aur kharche is phone mein save ho rahe hain aur internet aate hi bhej diye jayenge.
offline.queued: Is phone mein save ho gaya. Internet aate hi bhej diya jaye ga.
offline.sending: Phone mein save kaam bheja ja raha hai…
offline.failedN: {{n}} nahi bheje ja sake — wajah dekhne ke liye dabayein
offline.listHint: Internet ke baghair banaye gaye. Internet aate hi isi tarteeb se jayenge.
offline.waiting: Thori dair mein bheja jaye ga
offline.deleteAsk: Ye khatam kar dein? Ye server par kabhi nahi gaya.

modules.offHint: Software provider se kahein ke aap ki dukaan ke liye chalu kar dein.
modules.waText: Assalam-o-Alaikum, main apne Mobile Shop plan mein "{{module}}" shamil karwana chahta hoon.

fees.title: Software fees
fees.payInto: In mein se kisi account mein bhejein
fees.noAccounts: Software provider ne abhi accounts nahi likhe. WhatsApp par rabta karein.
fees.howTo: Easypaisa, JazzCash, SadaPay ya bank se fees bhejein, phir neeche transaction ID ya screenshot ke saath batayein.
fees.sent: Shukriya. Software provider check kar ke aap ka plan barha denge.

landing.badge: Pakistan ki mobile shops ke liye
landing.h1: Apni mobile shop apne phone se chalayein
landing.sub: Naye aur purane phone, bechne wale ka CNIC check, udhaar khata, marammat, accessories, WhatsApp raseed aur din ka hisaab — Urdu ya English mein, baray buttons, kisi training ki zaroorat nahi.
landing.waHello: Assalam-o-Alaikum, mujhe Mobile Shop software ke baare mein jaanna hai.
landing.point3: Internet ke baghair bhi chalta hai

used.d: Aane wale se CNIC photo aur eGadget check ke saath khareedein, iqrar nama print karein, har phone ki poori kahani IMEI se.

new.d: Brand aur model se stock, box pack aur open box, PTA / Non-PTA / JV SIM time ke saath, bill par tax, aap ke logo wala bill.

repair.d: Job sheet, parts aur labour, WhatsApp par status, bill ke saath hawalgi — aur ginti se accessories.

landing.videoSub: Ek sale, stock list, udhaar khata aur din ka hisaab — khud app par record kiya gaya.
landing.videoHint: Chalane ke liye dabayein. Awaz nahi.
landing.modulesSub: Basic cheezein har plan mein. Baqi jab zaroorat ho shamil karein.

sale.d: Phone chunein, paise lein (cash, online, cheque, bahar se ya udhaar), raseed print ya WhatsApp karein.

purchase.d: Dealer, customer ya doosri dukaan se; camera se IMEI; dabba, charger aur accessories darj.

stock.d: Har phone, tablet aur smart watch apni khareed, maangi qeemat, haalat aur stock ke dinon ke saath.

verify.d: CNIC scan se form bhare; bechne wale ki photo, eGadget nateeja, dastkhat shuda iqrar; chori ke phone ruke.

khata.d: Kis ne aap ko dene hain aur aap ne kisay, har bill aur adaigi chalte baqaye ke saath.

payments.d: Cash, bank, Easypaisa, JazzCash — har ek apne khate mein, galle ki ginti ke saath din band.

invoices.d: Thermal raseed ya A4 bill English ya Urdu mein, PDF download aur share.

returns.d: Phone wapas lein, katauti karein, cash ya credit dein; purana phone andar, naya bahar.

hisaab.d: Aaj, is hafte ya kisi bhi tareekhon ki bikri, haath mein, udhaar, kharche aur munafa.

staff.d: Malik, manager, salesman, technician — har ek wohi dekhe jo usay dekhna chahiye; PIN aur fingerprint login.

imei.d: Koi bhi IMEI scan karein: ye phone pehle yahan aaya? Kis ne becha, kis ne khareeda.

languages.d: Ek waqt mein ek zubaan, Nastaliq Urdu, right-to-left; print shuda kaghaz dukaan ki zubaan mein.

optional.accessories: Charger, cover, cable, watches ginti se, kam stock ke alert ke saath.
optional.repairs: Job sheet, parts, labour, WhatsApp par status, bill ke saath hawalgi.
optional.expenses: Qisam ke lihaz se roz ke kharche, tankhwahein, aur din band karna.
optional.held_sales: Bill rok kar agle customer ko nimtayein, baad mein dobara kholein.
optional.tax: Customer ke kehne par bill par FBR sales tax.
optional.exchange: Purana phone andar, naya bahar, farq ek hi baar mein tay.
optional.reports: Munafa o nuqsan, sab se zyada bikne wale, purana stock, andaze — download ya share.
optional.exports: Har report aur bill PDF, Excel ya CSV mein, WhatsApp par share.
optional.notifications: Customers ko raseed, udhaar ki yaad dahani, malik ko raat ki report.
optional.loans: Doosri dukaan ko amanat diye gaye phone, wapsi ya bikri tak nazar mein.

offline.d: Sale, stock aur adaigi phone mein save hoti hai aur internet aate hi chali jaati hai — sirf ek baar.

fingerprint.d: Website aur Android app par; staff bhi, jab malik ijazat de.

cnic.d: Card ki photo se number, naam, walid ka naam aur tareekhein bhar jaati hain — phone par parhi jaati hain, kuch upload nahi hota.

whatsapp.d: Raseedein, yaad dahaniyan aur reports WhatsApp par jaati hain — Business API ke saath khud-ba-khud.

landing.shotsSub: App se English aur Urdu mein li gayin.
landing.priceSub: {{n}} din muft se shuru karein. Mahina-war adaigi, koi contract nahi. Qeemat PKR mein fi dukaan.

plan.basic: Aise counter ke liye jo phone bechta aur khareedta hai.
plan.pro: Aisi dukaan ke liye jis mein marammat, reports aur WhatsApp ho.
plan.chain: Aise malik ke liye jis ki ek se zyada dukaanein hon.

landing.priceNote: Isi malik ki doosri branch Chain plan par banti hai. Android app shamil. Setup aur WhatsApp par training muft.
landing.startSub: Ye bharein; hum isi din aap ki dukaan khol kar login WhatsApp par bhej dete hain.
landing.sent: Shukriya! Hum jald WhatsApp par aap ka login bhejenge.
landing.paySub: Muft trial ke baad mahine ki fees in mein se kisi account mein bhejein aur screenshot WhatsApp karein (ya app mein Mazeed → Software fees mein batayein).
landing.payAsk: Accounts WhatsApp par bataye jaate hain.
landing.waPaid: Assalam-o-Alaikum, main ne Mobile Shop ki fees bhej di hai. Screenshot saath hai.
landing.waPaidBtn: Main ne ada kar di — screenshot bhejein

data.q: Kya mera data mehfooz hai? Kya doosri dukaanein dekh sakti hain?
data.a: Nahi. Har dukaan ka data alag hai aur har raat backup hota hai. Sirf aap ka staff, aap ke diye roles ke saath, aap ki dukaan dekh sakta hai.

phone.a: Nahi. Kisi bhi Android phone (app ya browser) aur iPhone / laptop ke browser par chalta hai. Thermal printer optional hai.

offline.a: Bechte rahein. Sale, stock aur adaigi phone mein rukti hai aur internet aate hi chali jaati hai.

staff.q: Kya mera salesman khareed qeemat dekh sakta hai?
staff.a: Sirf agar aap chahein. Malik, manager, salesman aur technician wohi dekhte hain jo aap ijazat dein.

cancel.q: Kya main kisi bhi waqt chhor sakta hoon?
cancel.a: Ji haan. Mahina-war adaigi; aap ka data aap ka hai aur kisi bhi waqt Excel mein download ho sakta hai.

landing.footer: Pakistan mein, Pakistani mobile shops ke liye banaya gaya.
